issues.description: Method PersonResource.updatePerson: the solution implementation declares the @PathVariable personId parameter as String, while the problem statement and NoteResource use UUID-typed path variables for resource identifiers. Problem statement: specifies PUT /persons/{personId} with a UUID parameter. Solution NoteResource.updateNote: uses @PathVariable("noteId") UUID noteId. Solution PersonResource.updatePerson: uses @PathVariable("personId") String personId. Template PersonResource contains a TODO (students expect to follow the same UUID convention). This mismatch is confusing because students will expect to use UUID path variables and compare UUIDs (updatedPerson.getId().equals(personId)) but the solution uses string comparison, causing uncertainty about the intended API contract and comparisons.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the signature of PersonResource.updatePerson to use UUID for the path variable: public ResponseEntity<Person> updatePerson(@RequestBody Person updatedPerson, @PathVariable("personId") UUID personId). Then validate with updatedPerson.getId().equals(personId) (as done in NoteResource) so the persons API consistently uses UUID path variables as specified in the problem statement.
